In a single unbroken scene. No scene cuts. Slow gimbal move only. No on-screen text. No music. No dialogue. No sound effects.
16:9. 35mm lens, f/2.8, camera at table height. A light-gray grooming studio, wall #E6E5E1. Large window key light from camera left, soft contact shadows, no flash, no beauty light.
[0-4s] The camera drifts in from the left across a pale gray grooming table. A real wet Yorkshire terrier lies on the table, tan facial hair in separate damp strands, one water bead on the black nose, dark eyes looking toward the lens. Only a groomer's forearms are visible: warm skin, short clean nails, turquoise cotton apron #0C6E78. The hands gently lift one wet strand. The dog blinks.
[4-8s] The same shot continues without a cut. A gray tabby domestic shorthair cat sits at the right edge of the table, watches the dog, then slowly extends one paw toward a single floating tuft of undercoat. The york's ear twitches. The camera keeps drifting.
[8-12s] The york gives one small shake. Fine droplets hang in the window light. The cat draws its paw back and settles. The camera eases back toward the opening angle so the clip can loop, and the york looks into the lens again.
Photographed on a full-frame camera, 24fps, natural grain. Imperfect wet fur, visible skin on the hands, uneven foam specks, micro-detail in whiskers and ear twitches. Lived-in studio.
No CGI. No plastic fur. No 3D character. No beauty filter. No lineup of animals. No logo. No letters. No stethoscope. No pet shop. No cages. No price tags.
